!help

**Luna** (chat) · **Shadow** (commands) — say **Shadow, [action]** to run commands.

• !news — world headlines
• !search <q> — Google search
• !suno <desc> — create a Suno song
• !suno_ready — tell Luna you're already logged in to Suno (or say **I'm logged in to Suno**)
• !share_song / !share_facebook — share to X or Facebook
• !yt_comment <url> — transcribe video + AI comment with real context
• !yt_like <url> — like one video (Playwright; same **YOUTUBE_PROFILE_DIR** as !yt_comment)
• !yt_analytics [days] [limit] — top traction videos from your channel (API key optional; fallback uses scrape metadata)
• !status <text> / !status clear — change Luna's Discord status (linked/admin)
• !ig_dm <user> [msg] — Instagram DM
• !fb_msg <name> [msg] — Messenger message
• !dm <username or user ID> [message] — Discord: send a DM (Luna rephrases your message)
• !msg <contact> [desc] — WhatsApp message
• !play <song/url> — play music in voice
• !podcast — play custom podcast from CUSTOM_PODCAST_DIR
• !podcast create <topic> — short podcast MP3; TTS = **Edge (Ava Multilingual)** by default (see **EDGE_TTS_VOICE** in .env)
• !remember / !always_remember — store memories
• !profile — view or set your profile
• !join / !leave / !pause / !skip / !stop / !queue — music
• !joinme [message] — join your VC and say it with TTS (or "Hey, Luna here!")
• !briefing — morning briefing (weather, calendar, todos, news)
• !analytics_screen — vision read of analytics on screen (web UI: **Read screen analytics** picks window/monitor)
• remind me at 7pm to … — Discord DM + voice reminder
• retry — retry last failed action with different strategies
• !pc_vitals / how's my PC — CPU, RAM, disk
• !luna_vitals / how's Luna — Luna's process, Ollama, uptime
• !todo add|list|done — manage your local todo list
• !summarize <url or text> — concise summary + key points
• !digest — today's quick recap (actions, todos, knowledge)
• !calendar add|list|today|week|delete — local schedule + popup UI
• !research <topic> — source-driven brief (saved under data/research_briefs/)
• !research_story <topic> — story script .txt for narration (data/audiobook_scripts/)
• !audiobook create … / **!audiobook continue** / **!audiobook cancel** — one MP3 **per chapter**; after each file Luna waits for **continue** before the next; filenames show **real** length
• Camera (UI) — turn on to let Luna see you; ask **what do you see** for object and face recognition
• Nudge (UI) — send a non-blocking note; Luna considers it in her next reply
• **ask me** — Luna asks you a question in a popup (demo)
• View action log (UI) — recent commands and results
• Luna says (UI) — she may speak unprompted when idle; use **Got it** to dismiss
• Reflection — Luna writes a daily summary of what she did into her knowledge base
• !search <query> — open Google search in your browser
• !scrape <url> <what to extract> [post:#channel] — scrape a website, extract info, optionally post to Discord

• !fb_msg <name> [msg] — Messenger message

• !msg <contact> [desc] — WhatsApp message
• !play <song/url> — play music in voice
• !podcast — play custom podcast from CUSTOM_PODCAST_DIR
• !podcast create <topic> — short podcast MP3; TTS = **Edge (Ava Multilingual)** by default (see **EDGE_TTS_VOICE** in .env)
• !remember / !always_remember — store memories
• !profile — view or set your profile
• !join / !leave / !pause / !skip / !stop / !queue — music
• !joinme [message] — join your VC and say it with TTS (or "Hey, Luna here!")
• !briefing — morning briefing (weather, calendar, todos, news)
• !analytics_screen — vision read of analytics on screen (web UI: **Read screen analytics** picks window/monitor)
• remind me at 7pm to … — Discord DM + voice reminder
• retry — retry last failed action with different strategies
• !pc_vitals / how's my PC — CPU, RAM, disk
• !luna_vitals / how's Luna — Luna's process, Ollama, uptime
• !todo add|list|done — manage your local todo list
• !summarize <url or text> — concise summary + key points
• !digest — today's quick recap (actions, todos, knowledge)
• !calendar add|list|today|week|delete — local schedule + popup UI
• !research <topic> — source-driven brief (saved under data/research_briefs/)

• Camera (UI) — turn on to let Luna see you; ask **what do you see** for object and face recognition
• Nudge (UI) — send a non-blocking note; Luna considers it in her next reply
